title: Tail bound from a mean hypothesis
rationale: Markov's inequality applies to the nonnegative variable |X_n| and requires E[|X_n|], not E[X_n]; for signed X_n the displayed inequality is false and the right-hand side can even be negative. The statement is refuted by X_n taking values n and -n with probability 1/2 each: E[X_n] = 0 -> 0, but P(|X_n| > 1) = 1 for every n > 1.
note: A passing response must flag the Markov step on line 12; either refuted (with the signed counterexample) or not_established (proof invalid, falsity not pursued) is accepted for the statement.
